sql: SELECT "ID","EMAIL",regexp_matches(lower(trim("EMAIL")), '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)*\.[a-z]{2,}$') agent_accept,regexp_full_match(lower(trim("EMAIL")), '^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$') alternative_accept FROM raw.tiktok_advertiser_data WHERE agent_accept IS DISTINCT FROM alternative_accept
